subject: german
title: Recht und Ordnung
welcome_lead: Law and order vocabulary opens civic German. Germany's Grundgesetz (Basic Law) is foundational.
meta_desc: German: law, order, justice, civic responsibility.
final_note: Civic German is the German of citizenship.

walkthroughs.body_html: Germany's constitution, adopted 1949. Article 1: Die Wurde des Menschen ist unantastbar (Human dignity is inviolable).
Der Richter, der Anwalt, der Prozess. Das Verfassungsgericht = Constitutional Court (in Karlsruhe).
For 'reduziert das Gefangnis die Kriminalitat?': use einerseits. andererseits.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I watch TV every evening' in German?
Where does the verb go after 'weil' (because)?
options: At the end of the clause.
Second position, as in main clauses.
Accusative (because it sounds like a direct relationship).
